name: Decks
_comment: Instrument: 2-deck DJ player locked to the Force clock (decks_engine.h), tracks from freely chosen folders on any mounted drive (decks_library.h). vst.json/module.json only feed mpc-vst-plugins' tools/gen_vst.py for params.h + the skin. The plugin is decks_vst.cpp, built by this port's own build.sh.
